items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Now he had sent Ziggy Elman some money to rejoin the band... So Ziggy say, 'Can't come. Need more money.' Sent him some more money. Ziggy didn't show up.

ctx.x: He didn't fine him, either. So now, we're at Frank Daly, you know, Pee Wee's helping Benny to change, helping him to dress, rather. And Sid and I were over in another corner, watching a checker game, with our backs turned.
So Benny asked Sid, he says, "Sid," he says, "What happened with that boy, Gillespie in Cab Calloway? Sid says, mum-mum-mum-mum, and when he said that, he tore out of the dressing room.
